lines.en: label mayafestival1:
I hear a door open from somewhere inside of a dream.
lines.zh: 我在梦里听见某处的门开了。

lines.en: Well, the door isn’t inside of a dream.
lines.zh: 好吧，门不在梦里。

lines.en: I am.
lines.zh: 在梦里的是我。

lines.en: Or was.
lines.zh: 或者曾经是。

lines.en: I don’t remember much of it, just that something was there.
lines.zh: 我不太记得那个梦，只记得那里有什么东西。

lines.en: I guess I’ve never been adept at recalling things I experience while unconscious, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想，我一直不太擅长回忆自己失去意识时经历的事。

lines.en: The scent of watermelon shampoo drifts closer to my bed, but I already had a feeling it was Maya who entered by the way the door sounded when it opened...
lines.zh: 西瓜洗发水的味道朝我的床飘近，不过从门开的声音我就已经猜到进来的是 Maya……

lines.en: Quiet and urgent, backed by a heavy dose of arrogance and the slightest hint of a sadness so great it could destroy the world.
lines.zh: 安静、急促，带着浓浓的傲慢，还有一丝足以毁灭整个世界的悲伤。

lines.en: I can’t wait to ruin her day.
lines.zh: 我等不及要毁掉她这一天了。

lines.en: scene mayabday1
: Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: : Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: I’ve seen this before.
lines.zh: 这一幕我以前见过。

lines.en: A slender girl in summer clothes, kneeling at my bedside- staring at me as I slowly return to the world.
lines.zh: 一个穿着夏装的纤细女孩跪在我的床边，盯着我慢慢回到这个世界。

lines.en: Not breaking eye contact despite how much she may want to. Not climbing into the bed despite how much I may want her to.
lines.zh: 尽管她可能很想移开视线，却没有移开。尽管我可能很想让她爬上床，她也没有爬上来。

lines.en: She probably would under the right circumstances, but my arms are far too weak to grasp at them and I’m far too tired to find them anyway.
lines.zh: 换个情形她说不定会的，可我的手臂软得抓不住那些理由，我也累得根本找不出它们。

lines.en: : I believe you’re supposed to say something to me right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在该对我说点什么吧。

lines.en: : I’ll take my eggs over medium. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我要半熟煎蛋。谢谢。

lines.en: : Something more celebratory.
lines.zh: : 说点更有庆祝意味的。

lines.en: : Happy anniversary, Maya. Here’s to a million more years or however long you’ve been wandering around inside of the bubble.
lines.zh: : 周年快乐，Maya。祝你再有一百万年——或者不管你在这颗泡泡里游荡了多久。

lines.en: scene mayabday2
: Close enough, I guess.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，我想。

lines.en: : A smile this early? Are you sure it isn’t {i}my{/i} birthday instead of yours?
lines.zh: : 这么早就笑了？你确定今天不是{i}我{/i}生日，而是你生日？

lines.en: : So you {i}did{/i} remember and were just electing to not say anything. I’m not surprised at all.
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}其实{/i}记得，只是选择什么都不说。我一点也不意外。

lines.en: : Fair warning, I might smile at several points throughout the day. You can stare in silence, but please don’t draw attention to any of them.
lines.zh: : 提前警告你，我今天可能会笑好几次。你可以安静地看着，但请别把注意力引到任何一次上。

lines.en: : It will make it harder to convince myself I’m not having any fun.
lines.zh: : 那会让我更难说服自己「我一点都不开心」。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’ll just keep track of them all mentally and provide you with a final tally at the end.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我会在心里一个个记着，最后给你一份总账。

lines.en: Smile Count: 1
lines.zh: 微笑计数：1

lines.en: : It’s going to be hard keeping track of anything if you don’t summon what little willpower you have inside of that body and get out of bed.
lines.zh: : 你要是不把那具身体里仅剩的一点意志力挤出来起床，我可什么都没法记。

lines.en: : Ten more minutes. You can climb in too if you want.
lines.zh: : 再十分钟。你想的话也可以爬进来。

lines.en: : I seem to have forgotten my pajamas.
lines.zh: : 我好像忘了穿睡衣。

lines.en: : Borrow Ami’s.
lines.zh: : 借 Ami 的。

lines.en: Wait. Ami.
lines.zh: 等等。Ami。

lines.en: : Does-
lines.zh: : 她该不会——

lines.en: : She’s at work and doesn’t know I’m here. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 她上班去了，不知道我在这儿。别担心。

lines.en: : Additionally, I may have eaten the breakfast she prepared for you in lieu of the birthday present you didn’t get me.
lines.zh: : 另外，我没收到你送的生日礼物，就把她给你准备的早餐吃了。

lines.en: : That’s because {i}I{/i} am the present.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}我{/i}就是礼物。

lines.en: scene mayabday3
: I wonder if there are any pawn shops open today that will accept a trade-in?
lines.zh: : 不知道今天有没有当铺开门，能收二手货？

lines.en: : Hey. You’re the one who asked for this.
lines.zh: : 嘿。是你自己要的。

lines.en: scene mayabday4
: That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Don’t make me regret it.
lines.zh: : 别让我后悔。

lines.en: Smile Count: 2
lines.zh: 微笑计数：2

lines.en: scene black
scene mayabday5
: What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : You know, out of all of the iterations of you that I have seen in the past, I can’t say that any of them have ever gone furniture shopping.
lines.zh: : 说起来，在我见过的你那么多个版本里，我还真没见过哪一个去买过家具。

lines.en: : I didn’t buy this. Someone made it for me.
lines.zh: : 这不是我买的。是有人给我做的。

lines.en: : You tricked someone into liking you so much that they handcrafted you a wardrobe?
lines.zh: : 你骗得有人那么喜欢你，居然手工给你做了个衣柜？

lines.en: : I feel like the lengths you have gone to for me are much greater than a few planks nailed together.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你为我做到的事，可比几块钉起来的木板要多得多。

lines.en: scene mayabday6
: Yes, well...don’t be expecting a new coffee table from me anytime soon.
lines.zh: : 是，嗯……别指望我短期内会送你一张新茶几。

lines.en: : So is this just how we’re going to spend the first half of your birthday? Walking around my room and commenting on all of my things?
lines.zh: : 那我们你这生日的前半天就这么过了？在我的房间里转来转去，点评我所有的东西？

lines.en: : It’s been a while since I’ve actually looked around in here. I want to see how much has changed.
lines.zh: : 我很久没好好看过这屋里了。我想看看变了多少。

lines.en: : That’s right. You must have spent a lot of time in here during our long history of you not being in love with me.
lines.zh: : 说得对。在你还没爱上我的那漫长历史里，你肯定在这儿待过不少时间。

lines.en: scene mayabday7
: Will that wardrobe fit a human body? Because I’m seriously considering crawling inside of it and dying right now.
lines.zh: : 那衣柜装得下一个人的身体吗？因为我真的在认真考虑爬进去死在里面。

lines.en: : It will fit Uta and she has significantly more...{i}width{/i} than you.
lines.zh: : 装得下 Uta，而她的……{i}宽度{/i}可比你大得多。

lines.en: : I take it her {i}width{/i} has been in there quite a few times by now, then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，她那个{i}宽度{/i}已经进去过不少次了？

lines.en: : Yes, but I was only there for one of them.
lines.zh: : 是，不过其中只有一次我在场。

lines.en: : You never cease to disgust me.
lines.zh: : 你从来没停止过让我恶心。

lines.en: : I think that’s on you this time because I really have not done anything unsavory involving this closet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这次是你的问题，因为我真的没在这个柜子里干过什么龌龊事。

lines.en: : What a world we live in where you feel obligated to confirm to me the household objects you have {i}not{/i} desecrated.
lines.zh: : 我们活在一个什么样的世界啊——你居然觉得有必要向我确认，哪些家具你还{i}没{/i}糟蹋过。

lines.en: scene mayabday8
: Now, please excuse me while I begin rifling through more of them.
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪一下，我要继续翻别的东西了。

lines.en: scene black
Maya paces around the room, inspecting a bunch of things and probably trying to find a new hiding spot for whatever fake journal she plants in here next.
lines.zh: Maya 在屋里踱步，一件件检查，大概是在给她下次要塞进来的假日记本找新的藏身处。

lines.en: She even goes as far as checking under the bed to see if I’ve been hiding any porn under there. Thankfully, I’m smart enough to-
lines.zh: 她甚至还查了床底，看我有没有在那儿藏色情刊物。还好我够聪明——

lines.en: : I assume you’re still keeping your stash under the mattress then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜你的存货还是藏在床垫底下？

lines.en: : Damn it.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: Maya removes a small stack of {i}research material{/i} from underneath my mattress and begins to flip through everything, entirely unfazed by the matter.
lines.zh: Maya 从床垫底下抽出一小摞「{i}研究资料{/i}」翻了起来，对这事一点也不觉得别扭。

lines.en: : I’m surprised Ami hasn’t found them yet. I can’t imagine she’d be very happy about-
lines.zh: : 我挺意外 Ami 还没发现。我猜她要是知道了会很不高兴——

lines.en: : Wait. What’s that?
lines.zh: : 等等。那是什么？

lines.en: : What’s what? Because I haven’t looked at {i}all{/i} of those magazines yet, and if there’s anything in there that’s weird-
lines.zh: : 什么什么？那些杂志我还没{i}全部{/i}看过，要是里面有什么奇怪的——

lines.en: : Not the magazines. What are those notes hanging up near your door?
lines.zh: : 不是杂志。挂在你门边那些便条是什么？

lines.en: Maya shoves my {i}research material{/i} back underneath my mattress and makes her way over to the door...
lines.zh: Maya 把我的{i}研究资料{/i}塞回床垫底下，朝门口走去……

lines.en: scene mayabday9
: How long have these been here, exactly?
lines.zh: : 这些到底在这儿挂多久了？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. I don’t ever really touch anything on that wall.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。那面墙上的东西我基本没碰过。

lines.en: : Who wrote this note?
lines.zh: : 这张便条是谁写的？

lines.en: : The one about the password or whatever? I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 写密码什么的那个？我确实不太清楚。

lines.en: : Because it sounds like something I would say. And it’s signed by an MM.
lines.zh: : 因为这听起来像是我会说的话。而且落款是 MM。

lines.en: : But I don’t recall ever writing this. And I know your password. It’s Boobies123.
lines.zh: : 可我不记得自己写过这个。而且我知道你的密码。是 Boobies123。

lines.en: : That it is, Maya. That it is.
lines.zh: : 没错，Maya。就是这样。

lines.en: : Anyway, is it possible that you just forgot you put this there?
lines.zh: : 总之，有没有可能是你忘了自己把它贴上去的？

lines.en: : It is {i}highly{/i} unlikely. Remembering is kind of my thing.
lines.zh: : {i}极{/i}不可能。记东西算是我的强项。

lines.en: : I thought watermelons were your thing?
lines.zh: : 我以为西瓜才是你的强项？

lines.en: : I have multiple things. I’m an incredibly complex girl.
lines.zh: : 我有好几样。我是一个非常复杂的女孩。

lines.en: : Sure are. I can’t say anyone else I know has ever messed with my...wall thing like this.
lines.zh: : 确实是。我认识的人里，还真没有谁像这样动过我的……那面墙。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t be so sure of that.
lines.zh: : 别那么肯定。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m going to leave another note here. Don’t touch it.
lines.zh: : 我要在这儿再留一张便条。别碰它。

lines.en: : I already told you that I don’t really mess with that wall.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，那面墙我基本不碰。

lines.en: : Then continue not messing with it.
lines.zh: : 那就继续别碰。

lines.en: Maya grabs a sheet of paper and a pen off of my desk, scribbling something down before sticking it to the board along with all of the other apparent non-Maya notes.
lines.zh: Maya 从我桌上抓起一张纸和一支笔，潦草地写了点什么，然后跟其他那些显然不是 Maya 写的便条一起贴到了板子上。

lines.en: After that, she immediately proceeds to exit the room without saying anything, so I guess the two of us are done hanging out in here for now.
lines.zh: 之后她一句话没说就径直走出了房间，所以我想我们两个在这屋里待着的部分到此为止了。

lines.en: scene mayabday10
It’s still a little early for any sort of festival to start, so I’m not really sure how Maya intends to kill the next several hours.
lines.zh: 现在离任何祭典开场都还早，我真不知道 Maya 打算怎么打发接下来的这几个小时。

lines.en: Or why she showed up even half as early as she did.
lines.zh: 也不知道她为什么要来得这么早。

lines.en: But hey, she wanted to spend the day with me. So if she wants the {i}entire{/i} day, so be it.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，她想跟我过这一天。那她想要{i}一整天{/i}，就给她一整天好了。

lines.en: I’m just glad Ami’s not here to see this because I can not imagine her taking it very well.
lines.zh: 我只是庆幸 Ami 不在，因为我实在想象不出她看到会怎么想。

lines.en: I’m also surprised that no one else asked me to this festival, but I guess my time would be better spent trying to figure out how to survive it with the person I {i}am{/i} paired with.
lines.zh: 我也挺意外居然没有别人约我去这个祭典，不过我的时间大概还是花在琢磨怎么跟眼前这个人一起活着撑过去比较好。

lines.en: : So...do you actually like festivals, Maya?
lines.zh: : 那么……你真的喜欢祭典吗，Maya？

lines.en: scene mayabday11
: Me? Of course. Why wouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我？当然喜欢。为什么不？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Something just feels off about the idea of you liking {i}anything.{/i} All of your interests take me by surprise even when I know they exist.
lines.zh: : 不知道。想到你居然会喜欢{i}什么{/i}东西，总觉得哪里不对。就算我知道你有那些兴趣，每次还是会被吓一跳。

lines.en: : I think you’re just projecting. I’m a normal [teenage]girl who likes most things that other normal [teenage]girls do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是在投射。我是个普通的[teenage]女孩，喜欢的东西和别的普通[teenage]女孩差不多。

lines.en: : Also, do you have any idea how much food is going to be at this place? Because it’s a lot.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你知道那地方会有多少吃的吗？多得很。

lines.en: : And despite how “surprising” my interests may be to you, I believe everyone has accepted my love for food.
lines.zh: : 而且不管我的兴趣对你来说有多「意外」，我想大家早就接受我对食物的爱了。

lines.en: : All I ask is that you don’t count on me winning you any prizes.
lines.zh: : 我只要求你别指望我给你赢什么奖品。

lines.en: : Oh, that’s fine. I already know you don’t possess the ability to win at any sort of festival game. My expectations could be no lower.
lines.zh: : 哦，没关系。我早就知道你没有任何祭典游戏能赢的本事。我的期望值不可能更低了。

lines.en: : Well, now I just feel compelled to prove you wrong.
lines.zh: : 那我现在反倒非得证明你错了。

lines.en: scene mayabday12
: Hah...you don’t have to do anything like that.
lines.zh: : 哈……你用不着做到那种地步。

lines.en: : I just want a normal day. I don’t get many of those.
lines.zh: : 我只想要一个正常的一天。这种日子我很少有过。

lines.en: : I want to eat. Walk around. Talk about things you’re not interested in and have you pretend that you are.
lines.zh: : 我想吃东西。到处走走。聊些你不感兴趣的事，而你装作感兴趣。

lines.en: : But, most importantly-
lines.zh: : 不过，最重要的是——

lines.en: scene mayabday13
: I want to be the cutest girl at the entire festival.
lines.zh: : 我想成为整个祭典上最可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : Is that real? Is that what you actually want?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你真正想要的就是这个？

lines.en: : It’s less what I {i}want{/i} and more...me looking forward to experiencing it.
lines.zh: : 与其说是{i}想{/i}要，不如说是……我在期待体验一下。

lines.en: : There’s something rather liberating about being the envy of everyone when you can’t get in trouble for it.
lines.zh: : 在不会因此惹上麻烦的时候，被所有人羡慕，有一种相当自由的感觉。

lines.en: : Well, I can definitely relate to that.
lines.zh: : 这个我倒是完全能体会。

lines.en: : No. That’s-
lines.zh: : 不。那是——

lines.en: scene mayabday14
: Wait. Ew. No. You {i}can{/i} relate to that.
lines.zh: : 等等。呕。不。你确实{i}能{/i}体会。

lines.en: : Ugh. I think I’m going to be sick. Why did you let me say that?
lines.zh: : 呃。我想吐了。你干嘛让我说出那种话？

lines.en: : Probably because, and this may upset you, so brace yourself- I can’t predict the future.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为——这话可能会让你不高兴，你做好准备——我没法预知未来。

lines.en: scene mayabday15
: Hah...the future. Right. I guess we should just talk about that now, then. So we don’t have to spoil the festival itself.
lines.zh: : 哈……未来。对。那我想我们现在就该聊这个了，省得把祭典本身搞砸。

lines.en: : Oh man. Is this one of your famous pre-reset lectures?
lines.zh: : 天哪。这又是你那套著名的重置前训话？

lines.en: scene mayabday16
: I’m going to ask you something right now, and I am going to be very direct about it.
lines.zh: : 我现在要问你一件事，而且我会非常直接。

lines.en: : All you have to do is answer yes or no.
lines.zh: : 你只要回答是或不是。

lines.en: : I will do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。

lines.en: : Then-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : Is there {i}any{/i} way {i}at all{/i} that Ayane is pregnant?
lines.zh: : Ayane 有没有{i}任何{/i}{i}可能{/i}怀孕了？

lines.en: : Or any of the girls you’ve been sleeping with.
lines.zh: : 或者跟你上过床的那些女孩里，随便哪一个。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Yes or no.
lines.zh: : 是或不是。

lines.en: : It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 这事很复杂。

lines.en: : It’s really not. You {i}do{/i} know how babies are made, correct?
lines.zh: : 一点都不复杂。你知道孩子{i}是{/i}怎么来的吧？

lines.en: : No. Do you think you could show me?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你能不能示范给我看？

lines.en: : I’m being serious right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在是认真的。

lines.en: : I get that. This is just a pretty random thing to be serious about.
lines.zh: : 我知道。只是拿这么一件事来认真，还挺随机的。

lines.en: scene mayabday17
: No. A “random” thing to be serious about would be polar bears or pogo sticks. This is a topic with direct relevance that, and I’m not kidding here, could screw {i}everything{/i} up.
lines.zh: : 不。值得认真对待的「随机」话题是北极熊或者弹簧高跷。这事可是直接相关的，我不是在开玩笑，它能把{i}一切{/i}搞砸。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : Let me ask you a question. Why do {i}you{/i} think Ayane made it to the roof last time? A feat that no one else has ever accomplished before. Why her?
lines.zh: : 我问你一个问题。你觉得上次 Ayane 为什么能上到屋顶？那可是从{i}来{/i}没有人做到过的事。为什么是她？

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: scene mayabday18
: Too slow- I’ll tell you.
lines.zh: : 太慢了——我来说。

lines.en: : Because you two had sex and she got pregnant. Which means she was carrying {i}your{/i} DNA inside of her. Which means she was a temporary extension of {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为你们两个上了床，她怀孕了。也就是说她体内带着{i}你的{/i} DNA。也就是说，她成了{i}你{/i}一个临时的延伸。

lines.en: : Do you see where I’m going with this?
lines.zh: : 你明白我说的意思了吗？

lines.en: : You’re saying that Ayane was only on the roof because she was pregnant with my child...which, no offense, sounds a little ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 你是说 Ayane 能上屋顶，只是因为她怀了我的孩子……恕我直言，这听起来有点荒唐。

lines.en: : What {i}isn’t{/i} ridiculous about this life we’re living?
lines.zh: : 我们现在过的这种日子，有什么{i}不{/i}荒唐的？

lines.en: : That doesn’t-
lines.zh: : 那不——

lines.en: : If she were pregnant, what happened? Because she doesn’t look very pregnant anymore.
lines.zh: : 如果她真怀了，那后来呢？她现在看着可不像怀着孕。

lines.en: scene mayabday19
: Gone with the reset, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概随着重置一起没了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It wasn’t meant to be there, so it was disposed of.
lines.zh: : 那东西本不该存在，所以被处理掉了。

lines.en: : I told you a long time ago. More than just memories can be altered by the shift in time. Physical attributes can be set back as well.
lines.zh: : 我很久以前就告诉过你。时间的变动能改的远不止记忆。身体上的特征也可以被拨回去。

lines.en: : I believe Ayane was rewritten to be the same exact person, just...without a parasite growing inside of her.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Ayane 被改写成了完全相同的那个人，只是……体内不再长着一个寄生物。

lines.en: : So when I ask you if there is any possibility of it happening again, I need you to answer honestly.
lines.zh: : 所以当我问你有没有可能再发生一次时，我需要你老实回答。

lines.en: : We may have gotten her back last time, but there’s no telling if it would work out that way again.
lines.zh: : 上次我们也许把她救回来了，但谁也说不准下次还能不能这么顺利。

lines.en: : So before you go thinking about how awesome it would be to mate with your entire classroom and never have to worry about having children, consider the price you’d have to pay.
lines.zh: : 所以，在你开始觉得跟全班交配又不用担心有孩子有多爽之前，先想想你要付的代价。

lines.en: : Potentially, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，只是可能。

lines.en: : This, like everything else, is all conjecture.
lines.zh: : 这个，跟其他所有事一样，全是推测。

lines.en: : But when everything is new, conjecture is all we have.
lines.zh: : 但当一切都是新的，我们手上也就只有推测。

lines.en: : I don’t want anything to go wrong.
lines.zh: : 我不希望出任何差错。

lines.en: : So I need you to start caring about everyone else a little more than you currently do.
lines.zh: : 所以我需要你开始比现在更在意别人一点。

lines.en: : You don’t need to beg me to keep me from fathering any children, Maya. I can assure you that is the last thing I want to do.
lines.zh: : 你不用求我别去当爹，Maya。我可以向你保证，那是天底下我最不想做的事。

lines.en: : You still haven’t answered the question. Is it-
lines.zh: : 你还没回答我的问题。到底——

lines.en: : Yes.
: It’s possible.
lines.zh: : 有可能。

lines.en: scene mayabday20
: I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : But I have no idea whether it’s true or not. So you’ll have to confront Ayane yourself if you want to know.
lines.zh: : 但我不知道这是不是真的。你要是想知道，得自己去问 Ayane。

lines.en: : Unless you’d rather just wait until we’re on the roof to find out, because there’s not much we can do at this point.
lines.zh: : 除非你宁愿等我们上了屋顶再知道，因为事到如今我们也做不了什么。

lines.en: : Are you really sure that’s what it is, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你真的确定就是这个原因吗？

lines.en: : Are you asking because you’re acknowledging the possibility that you may have planted your seed inside of others as well?
lines.zh: : 你这么问，是因为你也承认了你可能把种子种在了别人身体里？

lines.en: : And, if that’s the case- are you confused by how only {i}Ayane{/i} has made it there?
lines.zh: : 而如果是这样——你是不是也困惑，为什么只有 {i}Ayane{/i} 上去了？

lines.en: : Because these are things I’ve questioned myself as well. And I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 因为这些问题我自己也问过。而我也不知道。

lines.en: : I just don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道。

lines.en: scene mayabday21
: But I can’t think of any other reason why it would happen.
lines.zh: : 但我想不出还有什么别的原因会导致这样。

lines.en: : And I've tried.
lines.zh: : 而且我试过了。

lines.en: : The further we move into uncharted territory, the higher the potential is for risk.
lines.zh: : 我们越是往未知的地方走，风险就越大。

lines.en: : And I’m...
lines.zh: : 而我……

lines.en: : I’m finally starting to feel something again.
lines.zh: : 我终于又开始感觉到什么了。

lines.en: : I don’t want that to go away.
lines.zh: : 我不想让那种感觉消失。

lines.en: {i}A moment of silence.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一阵沉默。{/i}

lines.en: : Are you scared?
lines.zh: : 你害怕吗？

lines.en: {i}A crack in the glass.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}玻璃上的一道裂痕。{/i}

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 害怕。

lines.en: {i}A light in the attic.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}阁楼里的一盏灯。{/i}

lines.en: scene mayabday22
: Because I think that it might.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得它可能会消失。

lines.en: scene black
{i}A dream of the past.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一个关于过去的梦。{/i}

lines.en: The conversation drops dead after Maya’s revelation, but I must be forgiven for getting lost on this particular train of thought when the route-map is tangled up like wires.
lines.zh: 在 Maya 说出那番话之后，对话就死了，不过请原谅我在这条思路上迷了路——毕竟路线图缠得像一团电线。

lines.en: I don’t want to believe her but, at this point, I feel like I have to- because {i}I{/i} can’t think of any other reason Ayane would have made it up there with us either.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}不想信她，但到了这一步，我觉得自己不得不信——因为我也想不出 Ayane 为什么能跟我们一起上到那里。

lines.en: The gap we accidentally create in our morning is subsequently filled by a collage of uncomfortable glances and scattered trips to the refrigerator.
lines.zh: 我们无意间在这个上午制造出的空白，后来被一堆不自在的眼神和一次次去冰箱前的走动填满。

lines.en: Nothing is ever inside.
lines.zh: 冰箱里从来没有东西。

lines.en: At least nothing that either of us want.
lines.zh: 至少没有我们俩想要的。

lines.en: It ends, though- but I imagine that’s just because Maya wants to forget about this and focus on the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 不过这段空白终究还是结束了——但我想，那只是因为 Maya 想忘掉这件事，把心思放回今天剩下的时间里。

lines.en: She wants to eat.
lines.zh: 她想吃东西。

lines.en: She wants to walk around.
lines.zh: 她想到处走走。

lines.en: She wants to talk about things I’m not interested in and have me pretend that I am.
lines.zh: 她想聊些我不感兴趣的事，然后让我装作感兴趣。

lines.en: And strangely enough, I want to do all of those right now as well.
lines.zh: 而奇怪的是，我现在也全都想做。

lines.en: But we still have a few more hours of sunlight.
lines.zh: 可我们还剩好几个钟头的太阳。

lines.en: And many more unsuccessful trips to the refrigerator.
lines.zh: 还有更多次一无所获的冰箱之行。

$ maya_love += 1
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Two hours pass.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}两个小时过去了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maya changes into her yukata in the comfort of her best friend’s bedroom.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 在她最好的朋友房间里舒舒服服地换上了浴衣。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She looks beautiful.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她看起来很美。{/i}

lines.en: scene mayabday23
Smile Count: 3
lines.zh: 微笑计数：3

lines.en: : Welp...it will definitely be hard for anyone to take you down in your pursuit of being the cutest girl at the festival.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你想成为祭典上最可爱的女孩，看来谁都很难把你比下去。

lines.en: : For today and today only, I’ll allow you to say that as many times as you want without fear of being insulted.
lines.zh: : 只限今天，我允许你想说多少次就说多少次，不用担心被我呛。

lines.en: : It might be good to turn the cockiness down a little, though. Even if it is well warranted.
lines.zh: : 不过得意劲儿最好收一点。就算你确实有那个本钱。

lines.en: : It’s my birthday. I can be as cocky as I want.
lines.zh: : 今天是我生日。我想多得意就多得意。

lines.en: : Now, let’s get out of here before Ami comes home. I’m hungry and don’t want to deal with her today.
lines.zh: : 好了，趁 Ami 还没回来我们快走吧。我饿了，今天不想应付她。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, thank you for making the time for me...
lines.zh: : 那么，谢谢你为我腾出时间……
